# Core Contract — Read This First, Every Turn

## 1. Component Library: Base UI (`@base-ui/react`)
- Default headless foundation is **Base UI** (`@base-ui/react`), not Radix. Never import `@radix-ui/*` in new code; migrate legacy Radix/custom primitives when touched.
- Full conventions: [component-library.md](./component-library.md).

## 2. The 3 Architectural Layers & Direct Tag Ban
1. **Primitives (`src/components/ui/`):** Pure Base UI wrappers, design tokens, and controlled AI primitives (`PromptInput`, `ChatMessage`, `MessageScroller`, `ModelSelector`, `Trace`, `Tool`). Zero network/DB/auth logic; never import from `blocks` or `features`.
2. **Composite Blocks (`src/components/blocks/`):** Pure controlled UI assemblies built from `ui/` and tokens (props in, callbacks out; zero network/auth coupling). Never import from `features/` or `views/`.
3. **Feature Views (`src/features/` or `src/views/`):** Owns state, queries, auth, and routing; composes `blocks/` and `ui/`.
- **Direct Tag Ban:** Raw `<button>`, `<input>`, `<select>`, `<textarea>`, and `<dialog>` outside `src/components/ui/` are banned (Oxlint `eolas/no-raw-html-controls`). Always use `<Button>`, `<Input>`, `<Select>`, `<Textarea>`, `<Dialog>`, or `<UnstyledButton>` (for custom-styled bare buttons) from `@/components/ui/`.
- **Pre-Creation Workflow:** Inventory `src/components/ui/` and `src/components/blocks/` first → reuse or extend with props → only build new in `ui/` or `blocks/` if nothing fits.

## 3. API Preservation
Never erode component APIs, strip `ref` / Base UI `render` props, drop compound subcomponents, or downgrade primitives to `<div>`/`<button>` during styling or bug fixes. Make surgical diffs only.

## 4. Always-On Guardrails (Full List: [anti-patterns.md](./anti-patterns.md))
- **No triple-tint chips/badges:** Use Filled, Colored Outline + neutral `surface`, or Soft Wash (`*-container` + ultra-dark `on-*-container` on pills; `#1a1c1e` on callouts/cards).
- **Focus vs. selection:** Floating `outline-offset: 2px` for focus; flush `2px` border + surface wash for selection.
- **No child-margin hacks:** Never use `space-y-*` / `space-x-*`; use `flex gap-*` or `grid gap-*`.
- **No manual `<Icon>` margins:** Never add `mr-*`/`ml-*` inside buttons/menus/badges (`gap-2` handles spacing).
- **Shorthands:** Enforce `size-*` over `w-* h-*` and `truncate` over multi-class ellipsis.
- **Forms:** Wrap inputs in `<FieldGroup>` + `<Field>` + `<FieldLabel>`; use `<InputGroup>` + `<InputGroupAddon>` instead of absolute-positioned buttons.
- **Overlays:** Always render an accessible title (`<DialogTitle>`, `<DrawerTitle>`, or `sr-only`); never add manual `z-index`.
- **Triggers:** Never downgrade triggers with `render={<span />}` ("Behavior Wraps the Line").
- **Motion:** Never use `transition-all` or ad-hoc `@keyframes` sweeps (use `<ShimmerText>` / `<Skeleton>`).
- **Copy:** Plain everyday English, 1–2 nouns max per label; never expose dev/DB/CSS jargon (`committed`, `synchronized`, `affordance`, `telemetry`, `workflow`, `protocol`).
- **No registry bloat:** Never place domain-specific views or auth/SSE flows in `src/components/blocks/`.

## 5. Routing Index

| Task | Go here |
|---|---|
| UI/component/styling & WCAG 2.2 AA rules | [design-system.md](./design-system.md) |
| Component architecture, Base UI, navigation taxonomy | [component-library.md](./component-library.md) |
| Banned visual/code/copy patterns | [anti-patterns.md](./anti-patterns.md) |
| Color/type/spacing/motion tokens & component specs | project-root `DESIGN.md` |
| Adding/styling shadcn & Base UI components or applying `DESIGN.md` | `shadcn` skill + `DESIGN.md` |
| Responsive layout, RTL/i18n spacing, or worst-case UI stress testing | `better-layout` / `break-ui` skills |
| Motion implementation / tuning | `DESIGN.md` Motion section + `src/globals.css` & `src/components/ui/` motion primitives |
| Live a11y/browser debugging | `a11y-debugging` / `chrome-devtools` skills + Chrome DevTools MCP |
| Plain-English / patient / Easy Read / GDPR copy | `govuk-style` / `patient-communication` / `easy-read` / `gdpr-data-handling` skills |
| Firebase / Firestore / GCP project lookup | `firebase-*` skills + `firebase-mcp-server` (not `google-cloud-firestore`); `google-cloud-resource-manager` `search_projects` |
| Google/Firebase/Cloud docs | `google-developer-knowledge` MCP (`search_documents` fallback on 429) |
| Complex planning | `sequential-thinking` MCP |

Precedence: explicit user prompt > `DESIGN.md` > `.agents/rules/` > general conventions.

# Component Library — Base UI & Component Architecture

## Why Base UI (and not Radix)
This project standardizes on **Base UI** (`@base-ui/react`) as its headless primitive foundation:
- Actively maintained, single tree-shakable package (`npm i @base-ui/react`), and aligned with modern shadcn/ui Base UI patterns.
- **Never import `@radix-ui/*` in new code.** Treat existing Radix imports as migration debt and migrate to Base UI when touched.

## The 3 Architectural Layers

| Layer | Directory | Responsibilities & Contract | Import Rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Primitives** | `src/components/ui/` | Headless Base UI wrappers, design tokens, and controlled AI primitives. Zero business logic. | May import other `ui/` primitives & utils. **Never** imports `blocks/` or `features/`. |
| **Composite Blocks** | `src/components/blocks/` | Pure controlled UI compositions (props in, callbacks out). Zero DB, auth, or SSE/WebSocket coupling. | May import `ui/`. **Never** imports `features/` or `views/`. |
| **Feature Views** | `src/features/` or `src/views/` | Domain-specific screens, state, queries, routing, auth, and streaming recipes. | May import `blocks/`, `ui/`, and shared `lib/` utilities. |

### Form Composition (<FieldGroup>, <Field>, <InputGroup>)
- Wrap every form control in `<Field>` + `<FieldLabel>` (plus `<FieldDescription>` / `<FieldError>`) from `@/components/ui/field`. Never use placeholder text as the sole label.
- Group multiple fields with `<FieldGroup className="gap-4">` (or `gap-6`). Never use `space-y-*`.
- Compose leading/trailing icons, clear triggers, or inline buttons using `<InputGroup>` + `<InputGroupAddon>` + `<InputGroupInput>` + `<InputGroupButton>`. Never use manual `absolute` positioning inside inputs.

### Card Anatomy & Pragmatic `<div>`s
- Informational cards must use `<Card.Header>`, `<Card.Title>`, `<Card.Description>`, `<Card.Action>`, `<Card.Content>`, and `<Card.Footer>` (pure visual/media canvases exempt).
- Standard layout `<div className="flex flex-col gap-4">` / `<div className="grid ...">` containers are encouraged (never create `<Box>`, `<Flex>`, `<Spacer>`).
- Direct `<button>`, `<input>`, `<select>`, `<textarea>`, and `<dialog>` tags outside `src/components/ui/` are banned (Oxlint `eolas/no-raw-html-controls`). Use `<Button>`, `<Input>`, `<Select>`, `<Textarea>`, `<Dialog>`, or `<UnstyledButton>` / `<Button variant="unstyled">`.

## Primitive-Check-First Workflow (Mandatory)
- **Button `colorRole` vs `variant`:** `Button` decouples emphasis (`variant="filled" | "outline" | "soft" | "text"`) from M3 color role (`colorRole`); Emerald (`#00796B`) requires an explicit `colorRole="secondary"`, while secondary exit actions ("Cancel", "Back") use `colorRole="neutral"`.
- **Base UI ships primitives for:** Accordion, Alert Dialog, Autocomplete, Avatar, Button, Checkbox, Checkbox Group, Collapsible, Combobox, Context Menu, Dialog, Drawer, Field, Fieldset, Form, Input, Menu, Menubar, Meter, Navigation Menu, Number Field, OTP Field, Popover, Preview Card, Progress, Radio, Scroll Area, Select, Separator, Slider, Switch, Tabs, Toast, Toggle, Toggle Group, Toolbar, Tooltip (`https://base-ui.com/llms.txt`).
- **Custom primitives in `src/components/ui/`:** Card, Badge, Chip, InlineAlert, Icon, ClinicianTip, ThinkingOrb, BotAvatar, Avatar.Button, Breadcrumb, Pagination, EmptyState, Resizable, Attachment, ThinkingTrace, InputGroup, Field, Fieldset, Confirmation, and motion primitives (`Skeleton`, `TextSwap`, `NotificationBadge`, `TextsReveal`, `NumberRoll`, `NumberPopIn`, `SpinningCounter`, `ShimmerText`, `ErrorShake`, `SuccessCheck`).

1. **Inventory first** in `src/components/ui/` and `src/components/blocks/`.
2. **Reuse or extend** existing primitives with props before building new ones.
3. **Only build new** in `ui/` (Base UI wrapper) or `blocks/` (controlled composition) if nothing fits.
4. **Verify** no raw interactive HTML elements or duplicate primitives were introduced.

## Upstream Synchronization Policy
```bash
npx @seany9915/eolas-ui sync --dry-run
npx @seany9915/eolas-ui sync
# Or targeted overwrite:
npx @seany9915/eolas-ui add dialog combobox delete-confirmation-dialog --overwrite
```

## Navigation & Action Taxonomy (Choosing the Right Primitive)

| Primitive | Base UI Package | WAI-ARIA Role | Primary Purpose | When to Use | When NOT to Use |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **`NavigationMenu`** | `@base-ui/react/navigation-menu` | `<nav>` / `navigation` | Site & app routing | Top-level header with page routes & sub-nav | Executing commands (Save, Delete), form controls, or toolbars |
| **`Menu`** | `@base-ui/react/menu` | `role="menu"` / `menuitem` | Single-button action dropdown | Isolated action menus, `...` overflow menus | Multi-menu desktop bars (`Menubar`), global nav (`NavigationMenu`), right-click (`ContextMenu`) |
| **`Menubar`** | `@base-ui/react/menubar` + `menu` | `role="menubar"` / `menu` | Desktop app command bar | Document/IDE bars (File/Edit/View) with arrow hopping | Website page routing (`NavigationMenu`) or standalone dropdown (`Menu`) |
| **`ContextMenu`** | `@base-ui/react/context-menu` | `role="menu"` | Pointer-anchored secondary actions | Right-click / long-press shortcuts on rows/nodes | **Never** as the sole way to trigger an action (always pair with visible `Menu`/button) |
| **`Toolbar`** | `@base-ui/react/toolbar` | `role="toolbar"` | Persistent action strip | Formatting bars, playback controls (single tab stop) | Hierarchical dropdown menus (`Menubar`) or page nav (`NavigationMenu`) |
| **`Tabs`** | `@base-ui/react/tabs` | `role="tablist"` / `tab` / `tabpanel` | Mutually exclusive views on same page | Switching card/dashboard/profile panels | Executing commands or multi-select filters (`ToggleGroup`) |
| **`ToggleGroup`** | `@base-ui/react/toggle-group` | `role="group"` + `aria-pressed` | Mode/filter selection without panels | Segmented controls, filter bars, Grid/List toggles | Switching entire DOM content panels (`Tabs`) or URL routing (`NavigationMenu`) |

### AI Chat & Agent UX (<Trace>, <Confirmation>)
- **Pending approvals outside `<Trace>`:** Never nest `[Approve] / [Deny]` inside an expandable `<Trace>`. Render pending decisions as standalone `<Confirmation>` (or `<Questionnaire>`) blocks in the chat stream, collapsing into the trace only after resolution.
- **"Behavior Wraps the Line":** Keep disclosure triggers (`Collapsible.Trigger`, `TraceCollapsibleTrigger`, `Accordion.Trigger`, `Dialog.Trigger`) as real `<button>` elements. Never pass `render={<span />}` or `render={<div />}`.

## Styling & Animating Base UI Primitives
- Apply Tailwind v4 `@theme` tokens directly; style via Base UI `data-*` attributes (`data-open`, `data-disabled`, `data-starting-style`, `data-ending-style`) rather than duplicating state in React. Respect the root portal/`isolation: isolate` setup and never add manual `z-50` to overlays.
- **`className` for Layout & Structural Integration:** Call sites may pass `className` for layout/positioning (`w-full`, `max-w-md`, `mt-4`, `grid-cols-2`, `shrink-0`) and structural boundary resets when docking into a parent container (`rounded-none`, `border-0`, `bg-transparent`). Never pass arbitrary theme, color, or font overrides (`bg-red-500`, `text-gray-400`, `font-serif`)—use `variant`, `colorRole`, `prominence`, and `size` props.
- **Popup grouping & overlay titles:** Wrap `*Item` in `*Group` (`Select.Group`, `Menu.Group`, `ContextMenu.Group`). Every modal overlay must render `<DialogTitle>`, `<DrawerTitle>`, or `<SheetTitle>` (with `className="sr-only"` if visually hidden).
- **Motion:** Follow `DESIGN.md`'s 5 Motion Rules, explicit `transition-[...]` (no `transition-all`), and mandatory `motion-reduce:transition-none` / `prefers-reduced-motion`.

## API Preservation & Non-Destructive Refactoring
Retain all compound subcomponents, `ref`, Base UI `render` props, `cn(...)` merging, and existing prop aliases. Make surgical class diffs rather than full-file rewrites.

## The 6-Tier Functional Component Taxonomy
All components in Eolas UI are classified into 6 functional tiers (see `src/components/playground/registry/registry-manifest.ts` for the live inventory):

| Tier | Category | Directory | Representative Components |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Tier 1** | **Primitives** | `src/components/ui/` | `Button`, `Badge`, `Chip`, `Toggle`, `ToggleGroup`, `Input`, `Select`, `Switch`, `Slider`, `Tabs`, `Icon`, `Spinner` |
| **Tier 2** | **Fields** | `src/components/ui/` | `Field`, `Fieldset`, `InputGroup`, `Combobox`, `Autocomplete`, `OTPField`, `NumberField`, `Calendar` |
| **Tier 3** | **Composed** | `src/components/ui/` & `blocks/` | `Card`, `Table`, `Avatar`, `InlineAlert`, `EmptyState`, `Accordion`, `Collapsible`, `Toast`, `Chart`, `ClinicianTip` |
| **Tier 4** | **Overlays** | `src/components/ui/` | `Dialog`, `AlertDialog`, `Drawer`, `Sheet`, `Popover`, `Tooltip`, `Menu`, `ContextMenu`, `PreviewCard` |
| **Tier 5** | **Shell** | `src/components/ui/` | `Sidebar`, `Breadcrumb`, `Pagination`, `NavigationMenu`, `Toolbar` |
| **Tier 6** | **Clinical AI & Conversation** | `src/components/ui/` & `blocks/` | `ChatMessage`, `Trace`, `Reasoning`, `ThinkingOrb`, `Confirmation`, `Attachment`, `Sources`, `Checkpoint` |

## Known Component Traps & Edge-Case Guardrails
1. **Command Inline Mount Scroll-Jump:** Pass controlled `value={value}` + `onValueChange={setValue}` to `cmdk` so initial render doesn't jump the page.
2. **Sidebar Preview Container Isolation:** Wrap embedded sidebars in `<SidebarProvider className="min-h-0">` with `<Sidebar collapsible="none">`.
3. **DirectionProvider RTL Synchronization:** Mirror `dir={direction}` onto the container DOM element (`<div dir={direction}>`) alongside Base UI `<DirectionProvider>`.
4. **Resizable Panels v4:** Use `orientation="horizontal"` and percentage strings (`defaultSize="40%"`), not `direction` or numeric sizes.
5. **Control Height Synchrony:** Multi-control action rows (`Button`, `Input`, `InputGroup`, `Select`, `Toggle`, `ToggleGroup`, `Combobox`, `OTPField`, `Tabs`) must share identical height tiers (`sm`: 44px, `md`: 48px, `lg`: 56px).
6. **IME Composition Guard (`isComposing` + WebKit Timing):** Any text-input `onKeyDown` handler that submits or confirms on `Enter` (`PromptInput`, `InputGroup`, `Autocomplete`, `Command`) must ignore IME composition (`!e.nativeEvent.isComposing && e.keyCode !== 229`), and ideally guard against WebKit/Safari firing `compositionend` on the same tick just before `keydown`.
7. **Focus Recovery & Move Stability:** When an interactive list item is deleted or dismissed (`Attachment`, `Queue`, `Chip`, `DataTable` row), move focus to the next sibling, previous sibling, or container/add trigger rather than letting focus drop to `document.body`. On reorderable lists (`Sortable`, `Queue`), never use array index `key`s and preserve focus on the moved item's handle.
8. **Single Tab-Stop Roving Focus:** Horizontal chip bars (`SuggestionChips`), action strips, and custom grids should expose a single `Tab` stop with Arrow-key navigation (prefer Base UI `<Toolbar>` or roving `tabIndex`) rather than N separate Tab stops. Never use positive `tabIndex > 0`.
9. **Collapsed Panel Accessibility (`hidden="until-found"`):** Collapsed disclosures (`Collapsible`, `Accordion`, `Trace`, `Sources`) must use `hidden="until-found"` (with `beforematch` auto-expand) or `hidden`/`inert`—never `opacity-0` or `max-h-0` alone, which leaves hidden controls tabbable.
10. **Keyboard Parity for Reorder & Multi-Select:** Any drag-reorderable (`Sortable`) or range-selectable list must support keyboard reordering/selection (`Space`/`Enter` + Arrow keys or explicit Move Up/Down actions) and `aria-live` status updates.

- Base UI llms.txt: https://base-ui.com/llms.txt
- Base UI animation guide: https://base-ui.com/react/handbook/animation

# Design System & Accessibility Rules

**Source of truth:** @/DESIGN.md — canonical over anything below for all token values, contrast pairings, motion scales, and component specs. Check [anti-patterns.md](../rules/anti-patterns.md) before finishing any UI task.

## Styling & Token Directives
- **Tailwind v4:** Theme tokens live in `src/globals.css` under `@theme`. Never create a `tailwind.config.js`/`.ts` file or invent custom hex codes.
- **Component library:** Base UI (`@base-ui/react`) — see [component-library.md](../rules/component-library.md).
- **Shorthands:** Enforce `size-*` (`size-4`, `size-10`) over `w-* h-*` for square elements, and `truncate` over multi-class ellipsis strings.
- **Flex/Grid gaps:** Never use `space-y-*` or `space-x-*`; use `flex flex-col gap-*` or `grid gap-*`.
- **Icons:** Material Symbols only via `<Icon size="..." />` (`src/components/ui/icon.tsx`)—never add `mr-*`/`ml-*` inside buttons/flex containers (parent `gap-2` governs spacing). Use `aria-hidden="true"` on decorative icons, `aria-label`/`.sr-only` on standalone interactive icons, and `<Icon.Toggle />` / `<Icon.CrossFade />` for dual-state swaps.
- **Centralized loading/shimmer:** Never write ad-hoc `@keyframes` or gradient sweeps; use `<ShimmerText />` for text/reasoning and `<Skeleton />` / `<Skeleton.Reveal />` for spatial placeholders.
- **Descendant-scoped inverted surfaces:** For `<Card prominence="inverted">` (`#1a1c1e`), scope child styling via `[data-surface="inverted"]` or `&:is([data-surface="inverted"] *)` rather than `.dark` (reserved for a potential app-wide dark theme).
- **Container text split:** Callouts, `InlineAlert`s, and tinted cards keep `#1a1c1e` (`text-on-surface`) body copy with no colored perimeter borders. Small `<Badge />` and `<Chip />` soft pills (`variant="soft"`) drop the border (`border-transparent`) and use their ultra-dark semantic `on-*-container` tokens (`#001849`, `#00201c`, `#261900`, `#450a0a`, `#331400`, `#1a1c1e`).

## Layout, Typography & Responsive Architecture
- **Units & scales:** Relative units (`rem`/`em`) only. Body copy/tips start at `1rem` (`body-md`); dense tables/sidebars/metadata use `body-sm`/`caption` (`0.875rem`). Headings use `font-heading` + `text-wrap: balance`; paragraphs/prose use `font-sans` + `text-wrap: pretty`.
- **No uppercase or justified text:** Never apply `uppercase` (`text-transform: uppercase`) or `text-align: justify`.
- **Data tables:** Right-align (`text-right`) numeric columns (headers `<th>` and cells `<td>`) with `tabular-nums font-mono` (or `numeric: true` on `<Table />`).
- **Control height synchrony:** Side-by-side `<Input />`, `<Select />`, `<Textarea />`, and `<Button />` must share identical heights (`sm`: 44px, `md`: 48px, `lg`: 56px); buttons in flex rows use `shrink-0 whitespace-nowrap`.
- **Concentric nested radii:** Tight `p-1` segmented shells (`ToggleGroup`) step down to `rounded-sm` (`4px`). Nested media/cards/panels follow $R_{\text{inner}} = \max(8\text{px}, R_{\text{outer}} - \text{padding})$ (clamping to `rounded` / `8px` rather than `0px`).
- **Container vs. viewport queries:** Reusable components/blocks declare `@container` on a block-level wrapper with defined width (`w-full` or grid cell) and use `@sm:`/`@md:`/`@lg:` internally—never `<table>`, `<tr>`, or auto-sized flex items. Viewport breakpoints (`sm:`, `md:`, `lg:`) are reserved for page-level shells and the 12/8/4 grid in `DESIGN.md`.

## Strict Accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA) & Copy
- **Contrast & color independence:** Follow `DESIGN.md` pairings exactly; never convey state by color alone.
- **Touch targets:** `44×44px` (`2.75rem`) floor (WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.5) with stricter per-component minimums (`48px` buttons, `56px` interactive list rows) in `DESIGN.md`.
- **Forms, auth & landmarks:** Wrap inputs in `<FieldGroup>` + `<Field>` + `<FieldLabel>` (never placeholder-only labels), auto-focus the first `[aria-invalid="true"]` control on invalid submit (`<Form focusFirstInvalid />`), never block paste/autofill on auth inputs (WCAG 3.3.8), and keep `scroll-padding-block-start`/`end` for sticky bars (WCAG 2.4.11). Set explicit `enterKeyHint` (`send` on chat composers, `search` on search/filter inputs), `inputMode` (`numeric` on OTP/number fields), and `autoComplete` on specialized inputs. Use semantic landmarks (`<nav>`, `<header>`, `<main>`, `<aside>`, `<section>`).
- **Sticky composers & keyboard shortcuts:** Docked bottom composers (`Chat`, `PromptInput`) targeting mobile webviews should account for virtual keyboards (`visualViewport` / safe bottom insets) so the input stays visible. Format `mod+` shortcuts per platform (`⌘` on macOS, `Ctrl` elsewhere) in `<Kbd>` and pair hotkey-bound triggers with `aria-keyshortcuts`.
- **Focus & CSS content:** Never remove `:focus-visible` outlines. Never convey meaningful text solely via CSS `content` without alternative speech text (WCAG F87).
- **Motion:** Use `DESIGN.md` durations/easings, explicit `transition-[...]` (never `transition-all`), and mandatory `motion-reduce:transition-none` / `prefers-reduced-motion`. Restrict `--blur-*` to micro-primitives (`<TextSwap />`, `<Skeleton.Reveal />`, `<Icon.Toggle />`), never large text overlays.
- **Plain-English UI copy:** 1–2 simple nouns per label, user-outcome phrasing, zero dev/DB/CSS jargon.
- **Verification:** When a live page is available, audit contrast, focus order, and tap targets with the `a11y-debugging` skill (Chrome DevTools MCP).

# AGENTS.md

> Mirrors `.agents/rules/00-core-contract.md` (single source of truth) for tools following the [agents.md](https://agents.md) standard.

## Core Contract

1. **Component library:** Base UI (`@base-ui/react`), not Radix. Full detail: `.agents/rules/component-library.md`.
2. **Architectural Layers & Direct Tag Ban:**
   - **Primitives (`src/components/ui/`):** Pure Base UI wrappers, tokens, and controlled AI primitives (`PromptInput`, `ChatMessage`, `MessageScroller`, `ModelSelector`, `Trace`, `Tool`). Zero network/DB/auth logic; never import from `blocks` or `features`.
   - **Composite Blocks (`src/components/blocks/`):** Controlled UI compositions built from `ui/` and tokens (props/callbacks only; zero network/auth coupling). Never import from `features/` or `views/`.
   - **Feature Views (`src/features/` or `src/views/`):** Owns state, queries, auth, and routing.
   - **Direct Tag Ban:** Raw `<button>`, `<input>`, `<select>`, `<textarea>`, and `<dialog>` outside `components/ui/` are banned (Oxlint `eolas/no-raw-html-controls`). Use `<Button>`, `<Input>`, `<Select>`, `<Textarea>`, `<Dialog>`, or `<UnstyledButton>` (for custom-styled bare buttons).
3. **API preservation:** Never erode component APIs, strip `ref` / `render` props, drop compound subcomponents, or downgrade primitives to `<div>`/`<button>`.
4. **Always-on guardrails (see `.agents/rules/anti-patterns.md`):**
   - No triple-tint chips; use `*-container` + ultra-dark `on-*-container` on pills, `#1a1c1e` on callouts/cards.
   - Focus (`outline-offset: 2px`) vs. selection (flush `2px` border + surface wash).
   - No `space-y-*`/`space-x-*` (use `flex gap-*` / `grid gap-*`); no `mr-*`/`ml-*` on `<Icon>`; use `size-*` and `truncate`.
   - Wrap inputs in `<FieldGroup>` + `<Field>` + `<FieldLabel>`; use `<InputGroup>` instead of absolute input buttons.
   - Always include accessible overlay titles (`DialogTitle`/`DrawerTitle`); no manual `z-index`.
   - Never downgrade triggers (`render={<span />}`), never use `transition-all` or ad-hoc shimmer keyframes (`<ShimmerText>`/`<Skeleton>`), no registry bloat, and plain-English UI copy only (1–2 nouns; no dev/DB/CSS jargon).
5. **Design system & routing:** See `DESIGN.md`, `.agents/rules/design-system.md`, and `.agents/rules/00-core-contract.md`.

## Framework Architecture: Vite + React SPA
Client-side **Vite + React 19** SPA with Tailwind CSS v4 and Base UI. Never generate Next.js server components, App Router files (`page.tsx`, `layout.tsx`, `route.ts`), or `next/*` imports.
